Area.evidence_source: Seven broad codes were initially developed: trauma, social isolation, depressive symptoms, internalizing, remedy, health care, and messages to other men. In terms of weightings, data fitting with the trauma, social isolation, and internalizing codes were most consistently represented within and across all the interviews and became the focus of the analysis. The three inductively derived themes— (a) injury, (b) interiority, and (c) isolation—are presented separately though elements of each featured within and across the participant's interviews.
